svg.aria-label: Sequence of one tools/call. A 2026-07-28 client POSTs to /glygen/mcp with Mcp-Method, Mcp-Name and MCP-Protocol-Version headers and clientInfo in the body _meta. Traefik proxies to agentgateway, which forwards the call (auth passed through) to the upstream server and returns its result, tool error or JSON-RPC error. Traefik and the gateway each write an access-log line; the gateway's carries server, method, tool, outcome, protocol version, client name, User-Agent and a hashed client id. Vector tails both, keeps only schema fields and inserts into ClickHouse mcp_requests. Alternative: a legacy 2025-11-25 client first calls initialize and gets an Mcp-Session-Id; the gateway then reads method and tool from the JSON-RPC body and sets a legacy flag.
